title: Throttle
summary: throttle(fn, t): first call invokes immediately; during the next t ms calls are suppressed but the latest arguments are remembered; at the window boundary fn is invoked once with the remembered arguments if any arrived, and another t-window starts; continues until no pending call remains.
outputFormat: fn invoked at leading edge and at trailing boundaries

examples.output: invokes at 0 and at 100 with the 50 ms args, then window restarts
